goals.hint: Brewing stand: nether wart in water bottles, then magma cream.
goals.why: Immunity to fire and lava: for the Nether, blaze farms, the Twilight Fire Swamp and the Hydra.
steps: Craft a brewing stand (blaze rod + cobblestone) and fuel it with blaze powder.
Brew nether wart (from a fortress) into water bottles: Awkward Potion.
Add magma cream (slime + blaze powder) for Fire Resistance; redstone makes it last longer.

mobs.where: Blazes live in Nether Fortresses, around blaze spawners (a cage with a tiny spinning blaze inside). Bring fire resistance; snowballs hurt them. Carry a spawner home with a Diamond Chest Transporter for a blaze farm.

goals.text: Find a Bastion and trade with Piglins
goals.hint: Wear one gold armor piece and throw gold ingots to piglins to barter.
goals.why: Piglins trade ender pearls, obsidian, fire resistance potions, quartz and more for gold. Bastions hold netherite and gold loot.
steps: Wear at least one gold armor piece so piglins stay calm.
Throw a gold ingot to a piglin (Q) and pick up what it gives back.

mobs.where: Piglins live in Crimson Forests and the Nether Wastes and guard Bastions. Wear at least one piece of gold armor so they stay calm, then throw them gold ingots to barter.

goals.text: Ride a Strider across a lava ocean
goals.hint: Saddle a Strider and steer it with warped fungus on a stick.
goals.why: Striders carry you safely across lava.
goals.tip: Boats don't cross lava. Keep a marked way back.
steps: Bring a saddle, warped fungus on a stick, spare blocks and fire resistance.
Find a Strider by a lava sea, saddle it and mount it.
Steer with the warped fungus on a stick and get off on solid ground.

goals.text: Bring a Blaze Spawner home with a Diamond Chest Transporter
goals.hint: Only the diamond Chest Transporter picks up spawners (SF3 setting); the spawner keeps its mob.
goals.why: A blaze spawner at home is an endless blaze rod farm (brewing, eyes of ender, Create brass).
steps: Craft a Diamond Chest Transporter.
Clear the blazes around a fortress spawner and right-click the spawner with the transporter.
Place it at home in a dark, enclosed room with a kill spot.

goals.text: Grow Natura Nether trees and berries
goals.hint: Sift soul sand for Natura Nether saplings and berries.
goals.why: Natura trees don't generate in this pack; sieving is how you get them.
steps: Collect soul sand in the Nether.
Pick the soul-sand sieve recipe and mesh in JEI for the sapling or berry you want.
Plant it on its soil with clear space around it, then harvest and replant.

goals.text: Craft and power a generator of some kind
goals.hint: Simple Generators burn fuel, food or lava and charge machines next to them.
goals.why: Most tech machines run on FE/RF: a generator starts every tech path.
steps: Craft a Furnace Generator or any other generator.
Fuel it with coal or charcoal.
Put a machine next to it, or connect conduits or cables.

goals.text: Build an Extra Utilities generator
goals.hint: Fuel a Survival or Furnace Generator for FE.
goals.why: Machine power. Grid Power (GP), used by mills and some utility blocks, is separate.
steps: Craft a Survival or Furnace Generator.
Fuel it and connect an FE cable or a machine next to it.
Check power reaches the machine (GP mills don't supply FE).

goals.text: Build an XU2 Magmatic Generator
goals.hint: Lava in, power out. Built around a Furnace Generator.
goals.why: The second SF3 generator: steady power from crucible or pumped lava.
steps: Craft it from gold, a lava bucket, redstone and an Extra Utilities Furnace Generator.
Pipe or bucket lava in; connect a machine or cable.

goals.text: Build Solar Panels from Solar Flux
goals.hint: Panels make power in daylight; touching panels share it.
goals.why: Free daytime power, no fuel. Higher tiers make much more.
steps: Craft solar panels.
Place them under open sky, touching each other.
Connect one panel to a battery or machines; a battery covers the night.

goals.text: Store power in an RFTools Power Cell
goals.hint: Power cells store energy. Every side starts off: set them with a wrench.
goals.why: Stores generator overflow and keeps machines running at night or while generators refuel.
goals.tip: A new cell stays empty until its sides are set.
steps: Craft a power cell and place it between generators and machines.
Hit a side with a wrench (RFTools Smart Wrench or any wrench) to cycle it: input, output, off.
Sides at generators or cables: input. Sides feeding machines: output.
Stacked cells share capacity.

goals.text: Make a basic Ender IO capacitor and a Machine Chassis
goals.hint: Basic capacitor: copper, redstone, gold nuggets. Machine Chassis: iron bars and iron around a capacitor.
goals.why: Core ingredients of every Ender IO machine.
steps: Craft a Basic Capacitor (copper ingots, redstone, gold nuggets).
Craft the Machine Chassis: iron bars and iron ingots around the capacitor.
Build an Ender IO machine with it (the Alloy Smelter first) and power it.

goals.text: Make alloys in an Alloy Smelter
goals.hint: The alloy smelter makes electrical steel and the other Ender IO alloys.
goals.why: Ender IO machines, capacitors and conduits need its alloys (electrical steel, energetic alloy, conductive iron...).
steps: Craft the alloy smelter.
Power it; fill its three input slots (JEI lists every alloy).

goals.text: Automate turning Cobblestone into Gravel with a SAG Mill or Auto Hammer
goals.hint: The SAG Mill crushes cobblestone into gravel and doubles ore; the Auto Hammer is a powered hammer.
goals.why: Ore crushed into two dusts doubles your metal; gravel feeds the sieves.
steps: Craft a SAG Mill or an Auto Hammer.
Power it and feed cobblestone or ore; take output with a hopper or conduit.

goals.text: Use Ender IO Conduits to power several machines at once
goals.hint: One conduit block carries power, items, fluids and redstone.
goals.why: A tidy workshop: one line for everything.
steps: Craft energy conduits.
Run a line from a generator past your machines; it connects to each.
Add item and fluid conduits into the same blocks later.

goals.text: Automate a Sieve with a Mechanical Sieve
goals.hint: A powered sieve: hopper gravel in, drops out to storage.
goals.why: Sifting without clicking.
steps: Craft and power the mechanical sieve.
Insert a mesh.
Feed gravel with a hopper; pull the output into storage.

goals.text: Automate a resource with an Auto Heavy Sieve
goals.hint: The Auto Heavy Sieve sifts compressed blocks on power.
goals.why: Nine times the drops per sift.
steps: Craft and power it; insert a mesh.
Feed it compressed gravel, sand or dust.

goals.text: Use an Auto Compressor to pack a renewable material into compressed blocks
goals.hint: Packs 9 items into 1 compressed block automatically.
goals.why: Feeds heavy sieves and saves storage.
steps: Craft and power the auto compressor.
Feed it cobblestone, gravel or sand from a generator line.

goals.text: Process an ore piece into ingots with an Actually Additions Crusher
goals.hint: Crush ore in an Actually Additions Crusher, then smelt the dust.
goals.why: Ore doubling: one raw ore gives two dusts, two ingots.
goals.tip: Yields vary by recipe: not every input doubles.
steps: Craft the Crusher and connect FE.
Check your ore's recipe and yield in JEI.
Feed it, collect the dust and smelt it.

goals.text: Convert blocks with an Atomic Reconstructor
goals.hint: Its laser converts the block in front of it; lenses change the effect.
goals.why: Makes Actually Additions crystals (for its machines) and converts many items.
steps: Craft and power the reconstructor.
Put a block in front of it or throw items into the beam.
JEI lists every conversion.

goals.text: Make Steel with a Coke Oven and Blast Furnace
goals.hint: Coke oven: coal into coal coke. Blast furnace: iron + coke into steel.
goals.why: Immersive Engineering and many other machines need steel; coal coke is a strong fuel.
steps: Craft the Engineer's Hammer and read the Engineer's Manual.
Build a 3x3x3 cube of 27 Coke Bricks and hit the middle of a side with the hammer.
Burn coal into coke. Build a 3x3x3 Blast Furnace (27 blast bricks) and smelt iron with coke into steel.

diagram.title: Coke Oven
diagram.view: A solid 3x3x3 cube of Coke Bricks; hit the middle of one side with the hammer.
diagram.note: The Blast Furnace is the same cube made of Blast Bricks.

goals.text: Build and power an Immersive Engineering Crusher
goals.hint: Build the multiblock from the Engineer's Manual, form it with the hammer and power it.
goals.why: Crushes ores and other materials (metal equipment recycling is the Arc Furnace's job).
steps: Build the Crusher multiblock shown in the Engineer's Manual.
Hit the marked trigger block with the Engineer's Hammer.
Connect FE and put storage at the output.
Feed items into the top and collect the result. Stay out of the machinery.

obtain.immersiveengineering:crusher: Not crafted: build the multiblock shown in the Engineer's Manual and hit it with the Engineer's Hammer.

goals.text: Make Brass using a Blaze-heated Mechanical Mixer
goals.hint: Catch a blaze in an empty blaze burner and put it under the basin.
goals.why: Brass unlocks Create's advanced parts: brass funnels, mechanical arms, precision mechanisms, trains.
steps: Craft an empty blaze burner and right-click a blaze with it (or catch one at a spawner).
Place it under the basin and fuel it.
Copper ingot + zinc ingot + IE electrum nugget in the basin under a running mixer = 2 brass ingots.

goals.text: Assemble a Simulated Contraption with a Physics Assembler
goals.hint: Glue blocks together, put a Physics Assembler on them and pull its lever: they become a physics object.
goals.why: Create Aeronautics builds real vehicles with weight and momentum; you can stand on them, and chests and machines on board keep working.
goals.tip: Every block has a mass (F3+H shows Sable Mass): wood is light, iron and stone heavy. A slime ball merges two contraptions.
steps: Craft a Physics Assembler: lever over brass casing, andesite alloy on both sides.
Build a small platform and put the assembler on top (it grabs the block under it).
Use Super Glue (or Honey Glue) on two corners to select every block of the contraption.
Hold right-click on the assembler and pull the lever: the blocks lift off and get physics.
Use any Physics Assembler on it again to turn it back into blocks.

diagram.title: A first contraption
diagram.view: Layers from the bottom: a plank platform with the assembler on top
diagram.note: Glue the whole platform before you pull the lever. Pieces that are not connected split off as their own contraption.

goals.text: Assemble a Steve's Cart
goals.hint: Build modular carts in the Cart Assembler.
goals.why: Carts that mine tunnels, lay rails, farm and chop trees.
steps: Craft the Cart Assembler.
Add a hull, an engine and tool modules.
Assemble the cart and put it on rails.

goals.text: Move items with XU2 Transfer Nodes
goals.hint: A Transfer Node on a chest pulls items out into transfer pipes.
goals.why: Cheap SF3 item transport: one node per source, pipes to any inventory; upgrades add speed and stack size.
steps: Craft transfer pipes (smooth stone slabs, glass, redstone) and an Item Transfer Node.
Place the node on the side of the source chest.
Run pipes to the destination: items travel on their own.

goals.text: Move items with a Hopper Duct
goals.hint: A duct carries items like a hopper but doesn't pull from the container above.
goals.why: Cheap item transport.
goals.tip: A duct only carries what is fed in; it doesn't pull from chests.
steps: Place a hopper pulling from the source.
Point it into a duct route ending at the destination.
Check the duct direction, then send a few test items.

goals.text: Catch dropped items with a Funnel
goals.hint: A funnel on a chest collects items that fall into it.
goals.why: Drops from mob farms and broken blocks go straight into a chest.
steps: Craft a funnel.
Place it on top of a chest where items fall.

goals.text: Craft a Charset Pipe and Shifter
goals.hint: Shifters push items or fluids into pipes; pipes carry them to inventories.
goals.why: Cheap item and fluid transport before power-hungry networks.
steps: Craft pipes and a shifter.

goals.text: Power a Shifter and move items through connected pipes
goals.hint: A redstone signal runs a Shifter; a held redstone torch changes its mode.
goals.why: Your first automated item line: items move between chests on their own.
steps: Place a Shifter between the source and a Charset Pipe, facing the pipe.
Connect the pipe to the destination.
Use a held redstone torch on the Shifter to cycle Auto, Extract and Shift; rotate it with a stick or Charset Wrench.
Power it with redstone and check items move.

goals.text: Use a Shifter to transfer fluid through a Charset Pipe
goals.hint: Put a tank behind the shifter instead of a chest.
goals.why: Move water or lava between tanks without buckets.
steps: Put a tank behind the shifter.
End the pipe at another tank and power the shifter.

goals.text: Set and clear an item or fluid filter on a Shifter
goals.hint: Click a side with an item to filter it; empty hand clears it.
goals.why: Move only what you want: one pipe line can sort.
steps: Use a sample item on a non-output face of the Shifter to set its filter.
For fluids, use a filled bucket or fluid container as the sample.
Right-click the face with an empty hand to clear the filter.
Run a small transfer to check it.

goals.text: Move items with a Translocator
goals.hint: Two Item Translocators in the one-block gap between two inventories.
goals.why: Very fast item transfer between nearby inventories.
goals.tip: Basic transfer needs no redstone; redstone control is an upgrade.
steps: Leave one air block between the inventories and put an Item Translocator on each inward face.
Use their center controls: source to eject, destination to insert.
Send a small test stack to check the direction.
Add upgrades only for speed, filters or redstone control.

goals.text: Link an Ender Pouch to an Ender Chest
goals.hint: Ender chests and pouches with the same three-color code share one inventory.
goals.why: The same inventory from anywhere, even other dimensions.
goals.tip: Anyone with the same public code shares the contents: check the owner controls before storing valuables.
steps: Place an EnderStorage chest and set its three-color code with dyes.
Sneak-right-click the chest with an Ender Pouch to copy its code.
Open the pouch and check a test item shows in both.

goals.text: Collect nearby drops with a Random Things Item Collector
goals.hint: An Item Collector on storage picks up drops within 3 blocks.
goals.why: Collects farm drops automatically.
steps: Craft the Item Collector and attach it to an inventory.
Drop a test item within 3 blocks and check it goes in.
Keep space free; the Advanced Collector has adjustable range and filters.

goals.text: Redirect a dropped item into connected storage
goals.hint: An Item Redirector steers dropped items moving across it.
goals.why: Steer item streams into the right chest.
goals.tip: It steers dropped items; it is not a pipe into a chest.
steps: Place an Item Redirector in the path of moving dropped items.
Use a stick on its output side to set where items go; sneak-use the stick to set the input side.
Send a test item from the input side and check its new path.
End the path at a hopper or Item Collector on storage.

goals.text: Create a Refined Storage system to store your things
goals.hint: Controller + cables + disk drive + storage disks make one searchable network.
goals.why: Every item in one searchable terminal; it also runs autocrafting later.
steps: Craft and power a Solderer (quartz-enriched iron, sticky pistons): it makes the processors (printed processor, redstone, printed silicon).
Craft a Controller, cables, a Disk Drive, a Grid and storage disks.
Power the controller and connect everything with cables.
Put disks in the drive and open the grid.

goals.text: Autocraft with a Refined Storage Crafter
goals.hint: Encode patterns in the Pattern Grid and put them in a Crafter.
goals.why: Request 64 of anything and the network crafts it from stored ingredients.
goals.tip: Only processing patterns need an outside machine.
steps: Connect a Crafter to the powered network.
Encode a crafting pattern in the Pattern Grid and put it in the Crafter.
Store the ingredients in the network and request the item from a Crafting Grid.
Processing patterns: face the Crafter at the machine and send its output back to the network.

goals.text: Build a Quantum DSU
goals.hint: Holds billions of one item. Needs four Obsidian Chests and an Ender IO Machine Chassis.
goals.why: Perfect for cobblestone, dirt or ores from automation.
steps: Make four Obsidian Chests and an Ender IO Machine Chassis.
Craft the Quantum DSU.
Pipe items in from any side.

goals.text: Convert storage safely between a DSU and a Vast Storage Unit
goals.hint: A DSU alone in the center of the grid becomes a VSU, and back. Empty it first.
goals.why: The VSU shows its contents on a Simple Labels label.
steps: Empty the DSU first: converting deletes the stored items.
Put it alone in the center of the crafting grid.

goals.text: Fill a Quantum DSU with a renewable resource
goals.hint: Pipe a renewable resource into a DSU until it is full.
goals.why: An optional long-term stockpile challenge.
goals.tip: A huge endgame number, not needed for normal storage.
steps: Connect a renewable source to a DSU with enough transport.
Keep the source and storage loaded while you play.
Watch the count and plan for overflow (stop or void).
Tick this when the DSU is full.

goals.text: Build RFTools Modular Storage
goals.hint: Storage modules hold items; a Storage Scanner searches them.
goals.why: Carryable storage modules with a searchable interface.
steps: Craft the modular storage block and a storage module.
Insert the module and store items.

goals.text: Store Chisels & Bits bits in a Bit Drawer
goals.hint: A Bit Drawer (Drawers & Bits) stores bits by block type.
goals.why: Keeps bits organized.
steps: Craft the bit drawer.
Insert bits from your inventory.

goals.text: Craft an Iron Seed
goals.hint: 4 iron ingots + 4 intermedium essence around a tier 3 crafting seed = Iron Seeds.
goals.why: An endless iron farm with no mining.
steps: Upgrade essence around an Infusion Crystal: 4 inferium = prudentium; 4 prudentium = intermedium (the crystal is reused).
Craft a crafting seed and upgrade it to tier 3 with prudentium, then intermedium (JEI shows each step).
Craft Iron Seeds: 4 iron ingots and 4 intermedium essence around the tier 3 crafting seed.
Plant them on farmland; 8 iron essence craft into iron ingots.

goals.text: Use Growth Crystals or Growth Accelerators to speed up crops
goals.hint: Growth accelerators under the farmland (or a growth crystal nearby) speed up crops.
goals.why: Resource crops are slow; accelerators make them much faster.
steps: Craft growth accelerators (stone, inferium blocks, diamond) or a growth crystal.
Stack accelerators under the farmland (a taller column = faster), or place the crystal near the crops.

goals.text: Craft a Soulium Dagger and collect mob chunks
goals.hint: Kill mobs for mob chunks; chunk + essence around a crafting seed = mob seed.
goals.why: Mob seeds grow bones, string, gunpowder, ender pearls and blaze rods without a mob farm.
steps: Craft the Soulium Dagger (soulium ingots on a mystical tool rod) and kill mobs with it.
Collect mob chunks. Smelting a chunk gives a blank chunk; a blank chunk ringed with the mob's item (8 rotten flesh = Zombie Chunk) makes a chunk on purpose.
Craft the mob seed: the chunk and the matching essence around a crafting seed.

goals.text: Upgrade your mob farm to kill monsters automatically
goals.hint: Spikes or a Mob Masher saw kill mobs; an Absorption Hopper collects drops and XP.
goals.why: Drops and XP while you do other things.
steps: Put spikes or a saw at the kill spot.
Add an absorption hopper for drops and XP.

goals.text: Stop mob spawns around your base with a Mega Torch
goals.hint: A Mega Torch stops normal hostile spawns in its range.
goals.why: Fewer night spawns around your builds.
goals.tip: It doesn't remove existing mobs or stop spawners, raids or special modded spawns.
steps: Craft the Mega Torch and place it in the area to protect.
Check its range display or settings and cover gaps.
Seal entrances and deal with mobs already there.

goals.text: Pick up a mob with a Capturing Wand
goals.hint: Right-click a mob to capture it; right-click a block to release it.
goals.why: Move animals and mobs to your farms without leads.
steps: Craft the wand.
Right-click a mob to capture it.
Right-click a block to release it.

goals.text: Craft a Soul Cage for Soul Shards
goals.hint: Diamond on an obsidian-quartz-glowstone square = Soul Shard; kills fill it; a Soul Cage spawns that mob.
goals.why: Soul shards and Ender IO soul vials are one system: both feed the powered spawner.
steps: Build a flat 3x3: obsidian corners, quartz blocks on the edges, glowstone in the middle.
Right-click the glowstone with a diamond for an unbound Soul Shard.
Kill one kind of mob with the shard in your inventory: it binds and levels up.
Craft the Soul Cage (corrupted ingots + iron bars; corrupted ingots = vile dust from smelted soul sand, corrupted essence and iron) and put the shard in.

goals.text: Craft the SF3 Workshop Table
goals.hint: Engineer's Workshop: put a furnace or crafting table in a module slot and add fuel.
goals.why: One table runs several crafting and smelting modules from one fuel slot.
steps: Craft the workshop table and place it.
Fuel it.

goals.text: Add a crafting or furnace module to the Workshop
goals.hint: Each module slot runs one machine.
goals.why: One table smelts and crafts at once.
steps: Open the table.
Put a furnace or crafting table item into a module slot.

goals.text: Automate a Workshop recipe with an Auto Crafter upgrade
goals.hint: The Auto Crafter upgrade makes the crafting module craft by itself.
goals.why: Crafts whenever the ingredients are there.
steps: Craft the Auto Crafter upgrade and put it in an upgrade slot.
Set the recipe in a crafting module and feed ingredients.

goals.text: Expand the Workshop with a storage upgrade
goals.hint: A storage upgrade gives the workshop more inventory.
goals.why: Automation runs longer between emptying.
steps: Craft the storage upgrade and put it in an upgrade slot.

goals.text: Pack items into blocks with an AutoPackager
goals.hint: Packs 4 or 9 items into their block automatically.
goals.why: Compacts ingots, nuggets and gems to save storage.
steps: Craft the AutoPackager and connect FE.
Feed it with a hopper or pipe; put storage on its output side.
Right-click with an empty hand to cycle the crafting mode.
Feed enough identical items for a 2x2 or 3x3 recipe and check the output.

goals.text: Craft automatically with an RFTools Crafter
goals.hint: A powered crafter runs recipes by itself.
goals.why: Crafts components from ingredients piped in.
steps: Craft and power the crafter.
Set a recipe in its grid.
Pipe ingredients in and results out.

goals.text: Show live information on an RFTools Screen
goals.hint: Screens show power, inventories and more.
goals.why: Power, storage and machine status at a glance.
steps: Craft a screen and a screen controller; place them near each other.
Add modules (energy, inventory, clock) to the screen.

goals.text: Quarry or copy an area with the RFTools Builder
goals.hint: The Builder quarries or copies an area set by a card.
goals.why: Quarry huge areas or copy builds automatically.
steps: Craft the Builder and the card: quarry card to mine, shape card to build.
Set the area with the card and preview the bounds.
Connect FE and storage for mined blocks or building materials.
Test on a small area first.

goals.text: Infuse a machine to 100% with the Machine Infuser
goals.hint: Infuse an RFTools machine with dimensional shards: it uses less power.
goals.why: Infused RFTools machines use less power and work better.
steps: Craft and power the Machine Infuser.
Put an RFTools machine and dimensional shards in.

goals.text: Fly with a Simply Jetpack
goals.hint: Tier 1 jetpack: conductive iron, basic capacitor, leather strap, two thrusters.
goals.why: Your first flight: short hops and climbs on RF. Higher tiers fly longer and faster.
steps: Make conductive iron in the Ender IO alloy smelter and craft two tier 1 thrusters.
Craft the jetpack and charge it in an energy cell or charger.
Wear it and hold jump to fly. Jetpack keys (Controls) toggle it and hover mode.

goals.text: Take flight with a ring or jetpack
goals.hint: Fly with a Simply Jetpack (Age 4), the Angel Ring (Age 5) or Draconic flight (Age 6).
goals.why: Building and exploring get much easier.
steps: Craft a flight item and meet the power or gear needs in its tooltip.
Equip or carry it and turn its flight on.
Fly a short test near the ground and check its energy use first.

goals.text: Swap blocks with an Exchanger
goals.hint: An Exchanger swaps blocks in place for the block you pick.
goals.why: Turn a cobblestone wall into bricks in seconds.
steps: Craft an Exchanger Core (logs, red dye, ender pearl) and the wooden exchanger (logs, eyes of ender, core).
Sneak-right-click a block to pick it as the new material.
Right-click blocks to swap them; higher tiers swap a bigger area.

goals.text: Wear Long Fall Boots
goals.hint: Long Fall Boots stop all fall damage.
goals.why: No more fall damage while worn.
goals.tip: They don't protect from lava, the void or every modded damage.
steps: Craft the boots and wear them.
Check they are still on before working at height.

goals.text: Store experience in an XP Ring
goals.hint: An XP Ring soaks up nearby XP orbs; right-click to take the XP back.
goals.why: Keep XP safe until you enchant or repair.
goals.tip: It stores orbs you pick up, not levels you already have.
steps: Craft an XP Ring and keep it in your inventory.
Collect XP near it; its tooltip shows Internal Experience.
Right-click while holding it to get all stored XP back.

goals.text: Upgrade to a Diamond Backpack with a Magnet Upgrade
goals.hint: Upgrade the backpack tier by tier in the grid; a magnet upgrade pulls items to you.
goals.why: Far more space, and drops fly to you.
steps: Upgrade the backpack in the crafting grid: iron, gold, diamond.
Craft a magnet upgrade and put it in an upgrade slot.

goals.text: Make Plastic for Industrial Foregoing machines
goals.hint: Tree latex -> Tiny Dry Rubber -> Dry Rubber -> smelt into Plastic.
goals.why: Plastic builds Industrial Foregoing machines (plant gatherer, mob crusher...).
steps: Place a Tree Fluid Extractor facing a log to make latex.
Pipe latex and water into a powered Latex Processing Unit.
Craft 9 Tiny Dry Rubber into Dry Rubber.
Smelt Dry Rubber into Plastic.

goals.text: Build an Industrial Foregoing Simple Machine Frame
goals.hint: Dissolve plastic, a pity frame, nether brick, gold gear and IE steel into a Simple Machine Frame.
goals.why: Industrial Foregoing frames follow the SF3 tiers: steel, dark steel, then draconium plus a Twilight trophy.
steps: Make steel in the IE blast furnace.
Craft a pity frame, plastic and latex, then dissolve a Simple Machine Frame in the Dissolution Chamber.

goals.text: Make Menril Resin with a Squeezer
goals.hint: Squeeze menril logs (blue trees in meadows) for resin.
goals.why: Menril resin makes Integrated Dynamics cables, readers and logic cards.
steps: Find menril trees and collect logs and saplings.
Place the squeezer, put menril logs in and jump on it.
Collect the resin in a tank or bucket.

goals.text: Build an Integrated Dynamics logic network
goals.hint: Logic Cables, readers and Variable Cards (made in the Logic Programmer).
goals.why: Read machines, inventories and blocks and act on them with logic, no redstone.
steps: Connect Logic Cables and attach a reader to the block to inspect.
Open the reader, pick an aspect and write it to a Variable Card.
Put the card in a Display Panel on the same network to show the value.
Logic Programmer: constants and expressions. Variable Store: holds referenced cards.

goals.text: Move items with Integrated Tunnels importers and exporters
goals.hint: Item Interface on the source, Item Exporter with a valid Variable Card on the target.
goals.why: Moves items and fluids on your logic cables, with filters and rates.
goals.tip: Blank cards do nothing: exporters and importers need a valid aspect card.
steps: Put an Item Interface on a source chest and connect it with Logic Cable.
Put an Item Exporter on the destination on the same network.
Make a Boolean true Variable Card in a Logic Programmer.
Insert it in the exporter's Export All Items aspect and check items arrive.
Add item filters before connecting valuable mixed storage.

goals.text: Craft a Charset Tape Drive and Audio Cable
goals.hint: Craft a tape drive, a tape and audio cable (tapes: ingots, tape reels, smooth stone slabs).
goals.why: Records and plays back note-block music.
steps: Craft a tape drive, a tape and audio cable.

obtain.sf3extras:charset_audio_tape: Crafting table: three iron or gold ingots (or gems) on top, a Tape Reel left and right in the middle, three smooth stone slabs at the bottom. The reels must have tape on them.

goals.text: Record a short note-block melody onto a Charset Audio Tape
goals.hint: Connect note blocks to the drive with audio cable and press Record.
goals.why: Saves your music to play anywhere.
steps: Connect your note blocks to the drive with audio cable.
Insert a tape and press Record.
Play the melody on the note blocks, then press Stop.

obtain.sf3extras:charset_audio_tape: Crafting table: three iron or gold ingots (or gems) on top, a Tape Reel left and right in the middle, three smooth stone slabs at the bottom. The reels must have tape on them.

goals.text: Play your saved note-block recording
goals.hint: Right-click the drive with an empty hand and press Play.
goals.why: Plays back what you recorded.
steps: Rewind the tape in the drive.
Right-click the drive with an empty hand and press Play.

goals.text: Place a SuperCircuitMaker component on a circuit board
goals.hint: Right-click components onto a Circuit board in the world.
goals.why: Complex redstone in one block: a 7x7 board with four layers.
goals.tip: This port has no component picker: build on the board itself.
steps: Place a Circuit board with its top reachable.
Hold a component and right-click a cell on the board.
Empty hand: inspect or activate the component you aim at.
A Squeegee removes a component and returns its item.

goals.text: Build a powered circuit that controls a lamp
goals.hint: Route a signal across the board to its edge.
goals.why: The tiny circuit drives real redstone outside the board.
steps: Wire an input edge of the board to an output edge.
Power the input side; put a lamp next to the output side.

goals.text: Set a component's value or delay with the screwdriver
goals.hint: The screwdriver changes component settings.
goals.why: Timers, counters and repeaters need settings.
steps: Right-click a Constant, Timer or Delay with the Screwdriver to raise its setting.
Sneak-right-click to lower it.
Hold a stick in your offhand to rotate those components instead.
Sneak-use the Screwdriver on an empty cell to change the editing layer.

goals.text: Record and place a paid circuit blueprint
goals.hint: Record a finished board on a Blueprint, then build copies on empty boards.
goals.why: Copy a working design instead of rebuilding it.
goals.tip: Copying uses up components; a missing component means no copy, not a partial one.
steps: Use a Blueprint or Redprint on a finished Circuit board to record it.
Carry every component the copy needs and place an empty board.
Sneak-use the recorded design on the empty board.
Check the copy with a Multimeter and a test signal.

goals.text: Program a ComputerCraft Computer
goals.hint: Computers run Lua: type help to start.
goals.why: CC: Tweaked comes after OpenComputers: the computer needs an OC microchip (tier 1; tier 2 for the advanced computer).
steps: Place a Computer and right-click it.
Type edit startup.lua and write a small program, e.g. print("Hello, Otto!").
Save and exit, then run startup.lua.
Reboot and check the program runs on startup.

goals.text: Program a Turtle to mine for you
goals.hint: Craft a turtle with a pickaxe, fuel it and run excavate 8.
goals.why: A robot that digs a quarry while you do other things.
steps: Place a Mining Turtle facing a small test area and put fuel in its selected slot.
Run refuel all and check its fuel.
Run excavate 3 for a small first quarry; leave room and storage for the blocks.
Scale up once fuel, storage and the return path work.

goals.text: Build an OpenComputers computer
goals.hint: Build a computer with a CPU, memory, graphics card and a hard drive.
goals.why: A full computer in Minecraft for advanced automation.
goals.tip: Right-click the manual: it explains every part.
steps: Craft a Computer Case, CPU, memory stick, graphics card, screen and keyboard.
Craft the OC manual (book + microchip), a Lua BIOS (EEPROM + manual) and an OpenOS floppy (floppy + manual).
Put CPU, memory, graphics card and BIOS in the case; place the screen with the keyboard on it and a disk drive with the floppy.
Power the case (RF cable or Power Converter), press its power button and type install to copy OpenOS to a hard drive.

obtain.opencomputers:case1: OpenComputers parts use the mod's own recipes (circuit boards, microchips, iron); open JEI or the OpenComputers manual.
obtain.opencomputers:cpu1: OpenComputers parts use the mod's own recipes (circuit boards, microchips, iron); open JEI or the OpenComputers manual.
obtain.opencomputers:screen1: OpenComputers parts use the mod's own recipes; open JEI or the OpenComputers manual.
obtain.opencomputers:keyboard: OpenComputers parts use the mod's own recipes; open JEI or the OpenComputers manual.

goals.text: Program an RFTools Control processor
goals.hint: Visual programs that control machines and items.
goals.why: Control machines and item flow without writing code.
steps: Craft a Processor, a Programmer and a Program Card, plus the CPU and memory your program needs.
Power the Processor with FE and install the hardware.
In the Programmer, build a small event-driven program and save it to the Program Card.
Put the card in the Processor, trigger the event and check its log.
Add inventory and machine control once the simple program works.

goals.text: Craft a Mana Pool and a Mana Spreader
goals.hint: Generating flowers make mana; spreaders send it to pools.
goals.why: Mana powers all of Botania: manasteel, mana diamonds, runes, Terrasteel and the Gaia ritual.
steps: Make a generating flower (Endoflame burns fuel, Hydroangeas uses water).
Place a mana spreader near it and bind the flower to it with the Wand of the Forest.
Bind the spreader to a mana pool with the wand.

diagram.title: First mana setup
diagram.view: Top view
diagram.note: Flowers within 6 blocks of the spreader. Feed Endoflames coal or logs by dropping them next to them.

obtain.botania:special_flower: A functional flower is made by putting its petals and a mystical flower into a Petal Apothecary (see the Lexica Botania for the petal colors).

goals.text: Infuse Manasteel in a Mana Pool
goals.hint: Drop an iron ingot into a Mana Pool with enough mana for the recipe.
goals.why: Manasteel makes Botania tools and armor. Manasteel, mana diamonds and mana pearls make Terrasteel.
goals.tip: Each conversion only uses its recipe cost.
steps: Send mana from flowers to a Mana Pool through a bound spreader.
Check the pool has enough mana for the recipe (it needn't be full).
Drop an iron ingot in and collect the manasteel.

goals.text: Craft a Wand of the Forest
goals.hint: The wand binds flowers, spreaders and pools and shows mana.
goals.why: Links mana blocks and activates many Botania blocks.
steps: Craft the Wand of the Forest.
Switch it to Bind Mode (see its tooltip).
Sneak-right-click the spreader, then the pool, to bind them.
Use the wand on them to check the connection and mana.

goals.text: Infuse Terrasteel on a Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate
goals.hint: Manasteel + mana diamond + mana pearl on the plate, plus a lot of mana.
goals.why: Terrasteel makes the Terra Blade and Terra Shatterer and starts the Gaia ritual.
goals.tip: It needs a lot of mana. Picking up the ingredients early stops the craft.
steps: Build the livingrock and lapis platform exactly as the Lexica shows and put the plate on top.
Link mana to the plate with Sparks and store plenty before starting.
Drop one Manasteel Ingot, one Mana Diamond and one Mana Pearl on the plate.
Wait until the Terrasteel is finished, then pick it up.

goals.text: Craft and Place a Blood Altar
goals.hint: Altar: stone, furnace, gold and one Demonic Will. Fill it with your blood using a Sacrificial Dagger.
goals.why: Blood Magic turns your health (Life Points) into sigils, rituals and armor.
steps: Get a Demonic Will: throw a Soul Snare (string, iron, redstone) at a monster and kill it while snared.
Craft the Blood Altar (stone, furnace, gold ingots, the will) and a Sacrificial Dagger.
Right-click the dagger next to the altar to add blood (costs health: eat well).
Put items in the altar to transmute them with LP.

goals.text: Fill a Weak Blood Orb
goals.hint: A diamond in the filled altar becomes a Weak Blood Orb; right-click it to bind it.
goals.why: The orb holds your LP network. Sigils and rituals use it; each altar tier needs a better orb.
steps: Fill the altar with at least 2000 LP.
Put a diamond in: it becomes a Weak Blood Orb.
Right-click the orb to bind it, then leave it in the altar to fill.

goals.text: Make Blank Slates in the Blood Altar
goals.hint: Stone in a filled altar becomes a blank slate.
goals.why: Slates craft blood runes; runes raise the altar tier for better orbs, sigils and armor.
steps: Put stone in the filled altar.
Keep the altar filled until the stone turns into a blank slate.
Craft blood runes from slates and stone.

diagram.title: Tier 2 altar
diagram.view: Eight runes one block below the altar, all around it.
diagram.note: The 8 runes go one level lower than the altar, all around it. Higher tiers need more runes and pillars (see the Blood Magic guide).

goals.text: Craft a Sigil in an Alchemy Array
goals.hint: Draw an alchemy array with Arcane Ashes, then add redstone and a Blank Slate: Divination Sigil.
goals.why: Sigils are reusable LP-powered tools: Divination shows your LP; others give water, lava, air jumps, an item magnet and more.
goals.tip: The Air Sigil needs a ghast-tear reagent (128 will) and a Reinforced Slate: it comes after the first Tartaric Gems.
steps: Build a Hellfire Forge and make Arcane Ashes in it (redstone, white dye, gunpowder, coal; no will needed).
Right-click the ground with the ashes to draw an alchemy circle.
Right-click the circle with redstone, then a Blank Slate: it spins up and leaves a Divination Sigil.
Later sigils need a Hellfire Forge reagent and a better slate (JEI: Alchemy Array). Right-click a sigil to bind it.

goals.text: Collect Demonic Will in a Petty Tartaric Gem
goals.hint: Snared monsters drop Demonic Will; a Tartaric Gem in your inventory stores it.
goals.why: Will powers the Hellfire Forge and Will tools, armor and rituals.
goals.tip: Without a snare or sentient weapon, monsters drop no will.
steps: Throw a Soul Snare (string, iron, redstone) at a monster and kill it while snared: it drops will.
Hellfire Forge: will + redstone, gold, glass and lapis = Petty Tartaric Gem.
Forge a Sentient Sword (iron sword + gem): its kills drop will, and the gem picks it up.
Spend stored will on later Hellfire Forge recipes (reagents, better gems).

goals.text: Build a CAD and cast a Psi spell
goals.hint: Craft Psidust (3 redstone + ender pearl), build a CAD in the CAD Assembler and program spells.
goals.why: Program your own spells: mining lasers, flight, platforms, healing.
steps: Craft Psidust: 3 redstone + an ender pearl = 3 (pack recipe; later Psi spells make it too).
Craft a CAD Assembler (iron + piston) and the CAD parts: assembly, core (psidust in iron), socket, battery.
Assemble the CAD, write a spell in the Spell Programmer, put it on a spell bullet and load the bullet.

goals.text: Craft an Elementary Staff
goals.hint: Elementary staves cast fire, ice, wind and more from elemental essences.
goals.why: Ranged magic for Age 4 combat.
steps: Craft the staff.
Charge it with an essence and right-click.

goals.text: Assemble a Precision Mechanism with Create machinery
goals.hint: Sequenced assembly on a gold sheet with deployers (JEI shows the sequence).
goals.why: Needed for Create's advanced machines, arms and train parts.
goals.tip: The press only makes the starting gold sheet; it is not a step in the sequence.
steps: Open Precision Mechanism in JEI (Sequenced Assembly).
Feed a gold sheet through deployers that add a cogwheel, a large cogwheel and an IE electrum nugget, in that order.
Repeat the sequence as many times as JEI shows (loop or by hand).
Collect it; assembly can also give a byproduct.

goals.text: Keep a useful Create production line supplied and collect its output automatically
goals.hint: Feed inputs with funnels and belts; send outputs to storage.
goals.why: A hands-off line keeps making what you need.
steps: Supply inputs with funnels, chutes or mechanical arms.
Send outputs into storage.

goals.text: Fly a propeller airship you can steer
goals.hint: Propeller Bearings push a contraption; a Steering Wheel and Throttle Lever control it.
goals.why: A steerable flying base. Propeller bearings need Ender IO electrical steel (Age 4); smart propellers need vibrant alloy (Age 5).
goals.tip: Aviator's Goggles (leather + Engineer's Goggles) show thrust and stress. Gyroscopic Propeller Bearings stay level (helicopters). Thrust weakens high up; an Altitude Sensor reads air pressure.
steps: Start from a hot air balloon (or Levitite later) that holds its own weight.
Craft Propeller Bearings (wooden slab, electrical steel, brass casing). Put sails or an Andesite Propeller on each bearing's front (at least two sail blocks).
Give the bearings rotation, e.g. an on-board Portable Engine (burns fuel like a furnace).
Add a Steering Wheel and a Throttle Lever, glue everything and assemble it.
Reverse thrust by reversing rotation, or with a wrench on the bearing.

goals.text: Run a renewable material through processing into storage without manual item transfers
goals.hint: Connect source -> processing -> storage with pipes, ducts or a network.
goals.why: A material made, processed and stored without you.
steps: Pick a source (cobble generator), a processor (hammer, sieve) and storage.
Connect them with transport.

goals.text: Add an overflow plan so your resource factory can run safely
goals.hint: Void the excess (trash can, void upgrade) or stop the machine when storage is full.
goals.why: A full factory stalls or floods the ground with items.
goals.tip: Never put an unfiltered void on valuable mixed storage.
steps: Decide: stop when full, or void only a specific renewable excess.
Add filtered overflow storage and a void at lower priority, or a storage-full signal that stops production.
Fill a test destination and check the machine stops or voids only that excess.

goals.text: Drain a lake with a Ranged Pump
goals.hint: The Ranged Pump drains fluid in a large area into its tank.
goals.why: Clear water for underwater builds, or collect lava as fuel.
goals.tip: Empty its internal tank as it fills.
steps: Place the pump above the fluid to clear.
Power it (FE) and pipe it into an empty tank.
Check its range and let it drain; keep the area loaded.

goals.text: Keep a remote factory running with a Chunk Loader
goals.hint: A ChickenChunks loader keeps chunks loaded while you are away.
goals.why: Machines only run in loaded chunks.
steps: Craft a chunk loader.
Place it at the factory.
Right-click it to set the radius.

goals.text: Link machines wirelessly with Flux Networks
goals.hint: Flux plugs and points on one network send power anywhere.
goals.why: Power across your base, or across dimensions, with no cables.
steps: Craft a flux controller, flux plugs and flux points.
Plugs on generators, points on machines.
Put them all on the same network.

goals.text: Craft a TaCZ Attachment Workbench
goals.hint: Craft the attachment bench (needs Ender IO electrical steel) for scopes, grips and muzzles.
goals.why: Gun attachments are an Age 4 upgrade.
steps: Alloy electrical steel (iron, silicon, redstone) in the alloy smelter.
Craft the workbench.

goals.text: Craft a TaCZ Gun Smith Table
goals.hint: Gun Smith Table: IE steel ingots, logs and an iron block.
goals.why: Guns follow a supply chain: the table needs IE steel (pistols, SMGs); rifles, shotguns and snipers need Ender IO electrical steel; heavy weapons need Twilight and Aether materials (Age 5). Ammo needs pressed copper plates and the ammo workbench.
steps: Make steel in the IE blast furnace.
Craft the table.
Press copper plates (IE Metal Press or Create press) for ammo.

goals.text: Lift off in a hot air balloon
goals.hint: A Hot Air Burner under a closed envelope of balloon blocks lifts a contraption.
goals.why: Your first flying machine: you, friends and cargo over mountains and oceans.
goals.tip: Hold W over the burner or an envelope to Ponder balloons. Dye colors envelopes. Torches and glowstone on board light the ground below.
steps: Craft a Hot Air Burner (IE steel plates, block of coal, redstone, andesite alloy) and about 54 Hot Air Envelopes (wool + sticks).
Build a closed envelope, put the burner under it and light it.

diagram.title: Small hot air balloon
diagram.view: Layers from the bottom: deck, burner, posts and a 5x5 balloon
diagram.note: A bigger balloon lifts more. Lift gets weaker the higher you fly, so the balloon settles where lift equals weight.

goals.text: Drive a car on Offroad wheels
goals.hint: Wheel Mounts with Tires turn a contraption into a ground vehicle.
goals.why: Fast travel with cargo over land. Later, Rock Cutting Wheels on a Borehead Bearing make tunnel borers.
goals.tip: Hold W over a Wheel Mount to Ponder it. Heavy cars need more rotation: check stress with Engineer's Goggles.
steps: Craft Springs (iron sheets + iron nugget), then four Wheel Mounts (andesite casing, spring, iron sheet).
Craft four Tires (dried kelp around a shaft) and right-click one onto each mount.
Build a chassis with the mounts, a seat and a rotation source (e.g. a Portable Engine); glue it and assemble it with a Physics Assembler.
Rotation into the mounts drives the wheels. Redstone into a mount from the side steers it; from the top it brakes.

goals.text: Shape blocks with Extra Bit Manipulation sculpting tools
goals.hint: Sculpting tools add or remove Chisels & Bits bits in spheres and cubes.
goals.why: Big curved shapes in Chisels & Bits blocks, fast.
steps: Craft a sculpting tool.
Use it on blocks to add or remove bits.

goals.text: Use the Voxel Projector to display an item
goals.hint: The Voxel Projector shows a large hologram of an item.
goals.why: Big holograms for decoration and shops.
steps: Place the projector and use an item on it to project that item.
Stick = rotation, redstone = rotation speed, quartz = scale.
Sneak while using them to lower the value.
Glowstone dust toggles lighting; an ender pearl toggles random mode.

goals.text: Project a prepared VOX model with the Voxel Projector
goals.hint: Load a .vox model into the projector with a server command.
goals.why: Your own 3D models as holograms.
goals.tip: Needs a server-side file and command access; the item projection goal needs neither.
steps: The server owner puts the approved .vox file in config/randomthings/models/.
Stand at the projector and run /sf3voxel <model>.
Adjust rotation, speed and scale with the item controls.

goals.text: Open a Chance Cube - if you dare
goals.hint: Breaking a Chance Cube does something random: good or very bad.
goals.why: A gamble: diamonds, mobs, explosions or something silly.
steps: Craft or find a chance cube.
Break it far from your base.

goals.text: Find and fight a Lunkertooth
goals.hint: The Lunkertooth (Deep Below) is an ambush fish in ocean-floor ruins.
goals.why: Ruins hold a loot chest; one chest in three hides a Lunkertooth egg. Its Esca (rare drop) gives Greedy Eye (chest outlines) for the next ruins.
steps: Dive to the ocean-floor ruins.
Open the chests carefully: one may hide an ambusher.

obtain.mimicfish:esca: Esca sometimes drops from the Lunkertooth; eat it for about a minute of Greedy Eye, which outlines nearby chests.

mobs.where: Lunkertooth lives in the ocean-floor ruins of the Deep Below mod (it is not a dimension): it hides in the ruin chests and ambushes divers.

goals.text: Open a portal to the Wyvern Lair
goals.hint: Craft the Wyvern Portal Staff (Mo' Creatures) and use it to reach the Wyvern Lair.
goals.why: A dimension of wyverns, ores and floating islands; wyvern eggs hatch into flying mounts.
steps: Collect three hearts: fire (fire ogres, fire manticores, Nether hell rats), darkness (werewolves, dark manticores), undead (frost or toxic manticores).
Bottle each into an essence; combine the three with glowstone into an Essence of Light.
Craft the Wyvern Portal Staff (eye of ender, Essence of Light, blaze rod) and right-click with it.
Bring blocks: the lair is islands over a void. Use the staff again to return.

goals.text: Defeat Barako, the Sun Chief
goals.hint: Barako rules a masked Barakoa village in the savanna.
goals.why: Drops the Sol Visage, a mask that calls down sun strikes.
steps: Find a savanna village of masked Barakoa (huts and a throne).
Defeat the guards, then Barako. Move when the ground glows: his sun strikes follow you.

obtain.mowziesmobs:barako_mask: Dropped by Barako, the Sun Chief.

mobs.where: The Sun Chief sits on his throne in a Barakoa village in the savanna, guarded by masked Barakoa.

goals.text: Defeat the Frostmaw
goals.hint: A huge ice ape asleep in snowy biomes; its breath freezes you.
goals.why: Drops the Ice Crystal, which breathes frost on enemies.
steps: Search snowy plains and ice spikes for a sleeping giant ape.
Bring a bow and good armor; stay out of its breath cone.

mobs.where: Sleeps in snowy biomes (snowy plains, ice spikes). Its icy breath freezes you; fight it with fire resistance or from range.

goals.text: Defeat the Abyss Walker King
goals.hint: The king waits at the top of an Abyss Walker castle, 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn.
goals.why: A CQR tier 2 boss with Age 4 loot: the Walker sword and shield.
steps: Go 1,500 to 4,000 blocks out (Ring Map page) and find a dark castle.
Clear its floors, then fight the king. It teleports: stay in the open.

obtain.cqrepoured:sword_walker: Dropped by the Abyss Walker King.

mobs.where: Rules the Abyss Walker castles (CQR tier 2) in the middle ring, 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn.

goals.text: Defeat the Vessel
goals.hint: The Vessel haunts ruined temples in the middle ring and summons copies of itself.
goals.why: Drops ectoplasm and its vessel.
steps: Explore ruined temples 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn.
Find the real Vessel among its copies and focus it.

mobs.where: Haunts ruined temples in the middle ring, 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn (84 HP), and summons copies of itself.

goals.text: Defeat the Harbinger
goals.hint: The Harbinger appears at night 1,500+ blocks from spawn and drops the Reaper Scythe.
goals.why: The Reaper Scythe and Necronomicon pages open Harken Scythe soul crafting: essence keepers and the soul tools.
steps: Go 1,500 or more blocks from spawn at night, well armored.
Defeat it and pick up the Reaper Scythe and the pages.

mobs.where: Appears in the Overworld at night from the middle ring (1,500 blocks) outward. It carries the Reaper Scythe.

goals.text: Age 4 boss: defeat the Frostmaw (or Barako or the Abyss Walker King)
goals.hint: The Frostmaw opens Age 5 (New Worlds) for everyone on the server. The Twilight Forest and Aether portals open with it.
goals.why: When anyone on the server defeats one of these bosses, Age 5 opens for every player at once: its guide chapter, the reward bag and the decree of the age you finished. The Twilight Forest and Aether portals work for everyone from then on. Age 5 also brings terrasteel, Extreme Reactors, Draconic Evolution, the End and the Wither.
goals.tip: The killer, or anyone within 64 blocks when it dies, opens the age for the whole server. Nothing to craft or hand in. /sf3ages lists every gate.
steps: Frostmaw: snowy biomes, asleep in the open; it wakes when hit.
Barako the Sun Chief: chief of a Barakoa village in a savanna.
Abyss Walker King: the top of an Abyss Walker castle, 1,500 to 4,000 blocks from spawn.
Bring: your best Age 4 gear (dark steel or Tinkers weapons), a bow or gun, healing and fire resistance. Use ranged damage on Barako and the Frostmaw.
Defeat one. Chat announces the new age and this goal ticks itself (ages open in order).
Drops: Frostmaw: Ice Crystal. Barako: Sol Visage. Walker King: diamonds, emeralds, his sword and shield.

goals.text: Apply the Nether Decree to a Bounty Board
goals.hint: Open a Bounty Board, click the Nether tab on the left and place the decree in the empty slot: the page opens for good with Age 4 jobs.
goals.why: Opens the Nether page: Age 4 jobs (items and kills) that pay one notch ahead. Optional: bounties never gate progression.
goals.tip: Right-clicking the board with the decree also works. Breaking the board returns it and every decree on it. The goal ticks when anyone opens the page.
steps: You get the Nether Decree when Age 5 opens (every player gets one).
Right-click a Bounty Board to open it and click the Nether tab (left edge).
Place the decree in the empty slot on that page. The page opens for good and gets 3 jobs at once, then a new one about every 3 minutes (up to 9).

goals.text: Optional: finish three Nether bounties
goals.hint: Bounties are side jobs, never a gate. Use the Nether Decree on a Bounty Board and hand in three jobs.
goals.why: Every player gets the Nether Decree when Age 5 opens. On a board it offers Age 4 jobs (items and kills from every strand) that pay one notch ahead, never a skip. Skip a job you don't like and the board offers a new one. Bounties count for this decree until the next decree arrives.
steps: Craft a Bounty Board (6 planks + 3 paper) or use one in a village, and place it. The Bounty Boards page explains how jobs work.
Apply the Nether Decree to its page on the board (the goal before this one).
Hand in three bounties; this goal counts them for you.
goals.tip: Lost your decree? Craft a copy: decree + paper (you keep the original). Old capstones still make their decree.

goals.text: Enter the Twilight Forest and secure a safe arrival point
goals.hint: Ring a 2x2 water pool with flowers and throw in a diamond to open the portal.
goals.why: A dimension of bosses that unlock each other in order, with unique loot (Naga scales, Lich scepters, fiery tools).
goals.tip: The Magic Map (Twilight) shows the boss structures; each boss unlocks the next area.
steps: Dig a 2x2 pool one block deep and fill it with water.
Ring the whole pool, corners included, with dirt or grass and plants.
Throw in a diamond and stand clear of the lightning.
Enter, secure the arrival point and mark the return portal on your map.

diagram.title: Twilight portal
diagram.view: A 2x2 pool ringed by grass, with a flower on every ring block.
diagram.note: Any flower or tall grass works, on grass or dirt. Corners can stay empty. Two water buckets fill the pool.

obtain.minecraft:poppy: Pick flowers in grassy biomes, or use bone meal on grass to grow some. Any flower or tall grass works.
obtain.minecraft:grass_block: Mine grass with a Silk Touch tool, or place dirt next to grass in the light and wait for it to spread.
obtain.minecraft:water_bucket: Right-click any water with an empty bucket. A 2x2 pool refills itself.

goals.text: Collect Ironwood and Steeleaf in the Twilight Forest
goals.hint: Craft and smelt Raw Ironwood; Steeleaf comes from Twilight dungeon chests.
goals.why: Twilight gear and the dimension's crafting recipes need them.
steps: Collect Liveroot and the other Raw Ironwood ingredients (JEI) and craft Raw Ironwood.
Smelt it into Ironwood Ingots.
Loot Twilight dungeon chests for Steeleaf (it doesn't grow on trees).

goals.text: Defeat the Naga and obtain its progression reward
goals.hint: The Naga lives in a mossy stone courtyard; its scales open the Lich Tower.
goals.why: Opens the way to the Lich.
goals.tip: Pick up the drops yourself so the advancement triggers. Area still protected? Check the Twilight advancement tree.
steps: Find the Naga Courtyard (mossy stone walls).
Fight in the open: dodge its charges, hit its head.
Pick up the Naga scales and trophy.

mobs.where: Lives in the Naga Courtyard, a mossy stone-walled arena in the Twilight Forest. A Magic Map shows where.

goals.text: Defeat the Twilight Lich after completing Naga progression
goals.hint: Hit the Lich's pearl projectiles back to break its shields, then beat its later phases.
goals.why: The Lich unlocks the Labyrinth, Dark Forest and Snowy Forest, and drops the Zombie, Lifedrain and Twilight scepters.
steps: Finish the Naga advancement and find a Lich Tower.
At the top, find the real Lich among its invulnerable copies.
Hit its pearls back at it to break the shields; dodge the explosive fireballs.
Beat its later phases and take the scepter.

mobs.where: Waits at the top of the Lich Tower, a tall stone tower in the Twilight Forest. Defeat the Naga first or the tower stays sealed.

goals.text: Bring a trophy from a defeated Twilight Forest boss back to your base
goals.hint: Every Twilight boss drops a trophy.
goals.why: A decoration that plays the boss sound when powered.
steps: Pick up the trophy the boss drops.
Place it at home; redstone power makes it play the boss sound.

mobs.where: Lives in the Naga Courtyard, a mossy stone-walled arena in the Twilight Forest. A Magic Map shows where.

goals.text: Defeat the Minoshroom in the Labyrinth and eat its Meef Stroganoff
goals.hint: The Labyrinth is under the swamp (opens after the Lich). Its Minoshroom drops Meef Stroganoff, which lifts the Fire Swamp curse.
goals.why: The Fire Swamp burns you until you eat it; it leads to the Hydra.
steps: Find the Labyrinth under the swamp.
Defeat the Minoshroom.
Eat the Meef Stroganoff.

obtain.twilightforest:meef_stroganoff: Dropped by the Minoshroom in the Labyrinth.

mobs.where: Guards the deepest room of the Labyrinth, under the Swamp biome. Opens after the Lich; a Maze Map helps you find the way.

goals.text: Enter the Aether and secure your return route
goals.hint: Build a glowstone portal frame and pour water inside.
goals.why: A sky dimension with Zanite, Gravitite and three dungeon bosses that drop strong accessories.
steps: Collect 10 glowstone blocks (Nether) and build the frame.
Pour a water bucket inside it.
Step in. Bring blocks: don't fall off the islands.

diagram.title: Aether portal
diagram.view: Side view (stand it upright)
diagram.note: Corners optional. Pour water into the middle.

obtain.minecraft:glowstone: Glowstone hangs from Nether ceilings. Mining it drops dust; 4 dust make a block. Sifting dust also gives glowstone dust.

goals.text: Chop Skyroot and make Skyroot tools
goals.hint: Skyroot tools double Aether wood drops and mine Holystone.
goals.why: The first Aether tools; Holystone gives the next tier.
steps: Chop skyroot trees on the islands.
Craft skyroot planks and tools.
Mine Holystone with the skyroot pickaxe for holystone tools.

goals.text: Read the Aether Book of Lore
goals.hint: Put any Aether item in the Book of Lore to read about it.
goals.why: Explains every Aether item and block.
steps: Craft the Book of Lore.
Right-click it and put an item in the slot.

goals.text: Collect Zanite and improve your Aether equipment
goals.hint: Zanite tools get stronger as they wear down.
goals.why: Zanite is Aether iron, and gravitite mining needs a zanite pickaxe.
steps: Mine zanite ore (purple gems in holystone) with a holystone pickaxe.
Craft zanite tools.

goals.text: Craft an Aether Altar
goals.hint: The altar enchants items, fueled by ambrosium shards.
goals.why: Enchants gravitite and repairs Aether tools.
steps: Craft the altar from holystone and zanite.
Fuel it with ambrosium shards and put an item in.

goals.text: Use the Altar to obtain Enchanted Gravitite
goals.hint: Enchant gravitite ore in the Aether Altar.
goals.why: Enchanted gravitite makes the strongest Aether tools and armor.
goals.tip: Gravitite ore floats up when disturbed: keep track of it.
steps: Mine Gravitite Ore with a Zanite Pickaxe or better.
Put it in an Aether Altar fueled with Ambrosium Shards.
Collect the Enchanted Gravitite.

goals.text: Explore an Aether dungeon
goals.hint: Bronze dungeons are holystone rooms hidden inside big Aether islands.
goals.why: Dungeons hold the bosses and the keys to treasure chests.
steps: Find a bronze dungeon inside a big island.

goals.text: Defeat the Slider in the Bronze Dungeon
goals.hint: Hit the Slider with a pickaxe; dodge its charges.
goals.why: Drops the bronze key: treasure room with gloves and the Hammer of Notch.
steps: Use a pickaxe: swords barely hurt it.
Dodge its slides and hit it when it stops.

mobs.where: Sits in the boss room of a Bronze Dungeon, hidden inside Aether islands. Only pickaxes hurt it.

goals.text: Defeat the Valkyrie Queen in a Silver Dungeon
goals.hint: Silver dungeons are large white temples on clouds.
goals.why: Drops the silver key: valkyrie lance, armor and more.
steps: Defeat 10 valkyries in the dungeon for medals.
Give the medals to the queen to start the fight.

mobs.where: Rules a Silver Dungeon, a white temple on the clouds. Defeat 10 Valkyries there to earn medals before she will fight.

goals.text: Defeat the Sun Spirit in a Gold Dungeon
goals.hint: In a Gold Dungeon, hit the Sun Spirit's ice projectiles back at it.
goals.why: The final Aether boss: treasure includes phoenix armor and the vampire blade.
steps: Bring good gear, food and fire protection; enter a Gold Dungeon.
Start the fight through its dialogue.
Dodge the fire and hit the ice projectiles back.
Defeat it and use the key on its treasure.

mobs.where: Rules a Gold Dungeon inside the largest floating islands of the Aether.

goals.text: Visit an Ancient City and escape the Warden
goals.hint: Ancient cities are in the deep dark: sneak and avoid sculk shriekers.
goals.why: Enchanted books, echo shards (recovery compasses) and rare loot.
goals.tip: Sneaking doesn't silence everything. You don't have to fight the Warden.
steps: Search the Deep Dark with wool, food and an escape route.
Walk on wool and avoid sensors and shriekers; opening chests can make noise.
Loot carefully; leave if the warning rises or the Warden appears.

obtain.minecraft:echo_shard: Echo shards are found only in Ancient City chests deep below the surface (sneak, the Warden hears you).

goals.text: Travel to The Beneath Dimension
goals.hint: Craft the Beneath Teleporter and use it. Bring torches: it is very dark.
goals.why: A dark SkyFactory underworld with its own resources.
steps: Craft the Beneath Teleporter.
Use it, with torches.

goals.text: Kill a Wither
goals.hint: 4 soul sand in a T with 3 wither skeleton skulls on top. Fight it underground.
goals.why: The nether star makes beacons, the Nether Star Generator and many endgame recipes.
steps: Kill wither skeletons in fortresses for 3 skulls.
Build the soul sand T deep underground or in the End.
Place the skulls last.
Fight with a strong sword, healing potions and milk (cures wither).

diagram.title: Summon the Wither
diagram.view: Side view
diagram.note: Soul soil works too. The last skull you place starts the fight.

obtain.minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull: Dropped (rarely) by wither skeletons in Nether fortresses. Looting helps.
obtain.minecraft:soul_sand: Found in Nether soul sand valleys and around fortresses. Soul soil works for the Wither too.

mobs.where: Never spawns on its own: you build it. Put 4 soul sand (or soul soil) in a T and place 3 wither skeleton skulls on top, the last skull starts the fight. Do it deep underground or in the End, away from your base.
Wither skeletons spawn only in Nether Fortresses: tall black skeletons with stone swords. A Looting sword raises the skull chance.

goals.text: Build a Beacon on a pyramid
goals.hint: Beacon (nether star, glass, obsidian) on a 3x3 or bigger metal pyramid.
goals.why: Speed and haste at your base; the Gaia Guardian ritual starts at a beacon.
steps: Craft a Beacon and build a solid 3x3 base of mineral blocks (iron, gold, diamond, emerald...).
Place the Beacon in the center on top with a clear view of the sky.
Open it, pick an effect and pay with an ingot or gem.
Add full pyramid layers later for more effects and range.

diagram.title: Beacon base
diagram.view: A beacon on a 3x3 layer of metal blocks.
diagram.note: Gold, diamond, emerald or netherite blocks work too.

goals.text: Automate Wither killing
goals.hint: Trap a Wither in an unbreakable cage, kill it automatically and collect the star.
goals.why: Endless nether stars for beacons, generators and endgame recipes.
steps: Build a cage the Wither can't break.
Add automated damage (spikes, mob masher) and a collector for the star.

goals.text: Make a Netherite Ingot
goals.hint: Smelt ancient debris (deep Nether) into scrap; 4 scrap + 4 gold = 1 ingot.
goals.why: Netherite is the strongest vanilla gear and doesn't burn.
goals.tip: Templates are used up. Beds explode in the Nether: tunnel-mine instead.
steps: Mine Ancient Debris deep in the Nether with a diamond pickaxe or better.
Smelt it into Netherite Scrap; craft 4 scrap + 4 gold ingots into a Netherite Ingot.
Get a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template from a bastion; duplicate it before using your last one.
Smithing Table: template + diamond gear + ingot.

goals.text: Craft a Diamond Seed
goals.hint: 4 diamonds + 4 supremium essence around a tier 5 crafting seed = Diamond Seeds.
goals.why: Renewable diamonds.
goals.tip: Farmland and growth devices give the bonuses in their tooltips; higher-tier farmland is not a flat speed boost.
steps: Upgrade essence through every tier to supremium (4 of one tier + an Infusion Crystal make the next).
Upgrade a crafting seed to tier 5.
Craft Diamond Seeds: 4 diamonds and 4 supremium essence around the tier 5 seed.
Plant them and craft the harvested essence into diamonds.

goals.text: Craft a Supremium Apple
goals.hint: Craft a Supremium Apple from supremium essence.
goals.why: Strong effects (regeneration, resistance and more) for boss fights.
steps: Craft it from supremium essence.

goals.text: Automate crop harvesting
goals.hint: The Ender IO Farming Station or the Industrial Foregoing Plant Gatherer harvests for you.
goals.why: Farms with no clicking.
steps: Pick a Farming Station or a Plant Gatherer for your crop.
Power it (FE) and check its working area.
Farming Station: give it tools, seeds and a capacitor. Industrial Foregoing: add a Plant Sower to replant.
Send the harvest into storage, keeping enough seeds to replant.

goals.text: Build an Industrial Foregoing Advanced Machine Frame
goals.hint: Advanced frames need Ender IO dark steel and pink slime.
goals.why: Unlocks mid-tier Industrial Foregoing machines (laser drill, enchantment machines).
steps: Alloy dark steel in an Ender IO alloy smelter.
Dissolve plastic, a Simple frame, netherite scrap and dark steel with pink slime.

goals.text: Open a portal to Alfheim with an Elven Gateway Core
goals.hint: Livingwood frame with glimmering livingwood, Natura Pylons on mana pools, then the wand on the core.
goals.why: Elves trade Elementium, Pixie Dust and Dragonstone.
steps: Build the livingwood frame (Lexica, "Alfheim").
Put two Natura pylons on mana pools next to it.
Use the wand on the core.

goals.text: Walk on air with a Sigil of the Phantom Bridge
goals.hint: This sigil builds a short-lived path under your feet: the classic SkyFactory 3 way to cross the void.
goals.why: A safe walkway anywhere, paid for with LP instead of blocks.
steps: Upgrade your Blood Altar and orb until the sigil can be made (press G on it to see the recipe).
Craft the sigil and bind it to yourself.
Switch it on and walk off a ledge: a phantom path forms under you while your LP lasts.

goals.text: Craft a Bound Blade or Bound tool
goals.hint: Bound tools run on LP from your soul network instead of durability.
goals.why: SkyFactory 3 asked for the Bound Blade, Pickaxe, Axe and Shovel; one is enough to learn how they work.
steps: Press G on a Bound tool to see its recipe and the gem it needs.
Craft it and bind it to yourself, then switch it on.
It drains LP while it is on, so keep your altar running.

goals.text: Smelt Yellorite into Yellorium Ingots
goals.hint: Smelt yellorite ore (Overworld, underground) into yellorium.
goals.why: Yellorium fuels Extreme Reactors.
steps: Find yellorite ore (yellow specks) underground.
Smelt it into yellorium ingots.

obtain.bigreactors:yellorium_ingot: Smelt yellorite ore (or raw yellorium), found underground in the Overworld.

goals.text: Create a passively cooled reactor from Extreme Reactors
goals.hint: Casing, controller, yellorium fuel rods, control rods, access port and a power tap.
goals.why: Huge power from a little fuel.
steps: Build the hollow casing with room for fuel-rod columns.
Top each fuel column with a Reactor Control Rod in the roof.
Add the Controller, a solid Access Port and a passive FE Power Tap (all the same reactor tier).
Check the Controller for errors, insert fuel through the Access Port and connect energy storage.
Start at low demand; watch fuel and heat and adjust control rods before scaling up.

diagram.title: Smallest reactor (3x3x3)
diagram.view: One fuel rod in the middle, a control rod on top of it, the rest casing with the ports on the sides.
diagram.note: Bigger reactors: more fuel rod columns, each with a control rod on top. Reactor glass can replace casing on the faces.

goals.text: Assemble an Advanced Generators gas turbine
goals.hint: Connect a Gas Turbine Controller to its modules; right-click it for status.
goals.why: Advanced Generators turn fuels and steam into large amounts of power.
steps: Place a Gas Turbine Controller and connect at least one turbine module.
Attach a Fuel Input and an RF Output module to the same structure.
Right-click the Controller and fix any missing-module or limit messages.
Check its turbine capacity before adding fuel.

goals.text: Fuel a gas turbine and send its power to a machine
goals.hint: Pipe fuel into the Fuel Input; take power from the RF Output.
goals.why: Burns fuels (fire water, rocket fuel...) for power.
steps: Pick an accepted fuel (JEI).
Pipe it into the Fuel Input of the built turbine.
Connect the RF Output to a machine or storage.
Check the Controller shows fuel use and power out.

goals.text: Form a steam turbine and produce power from steam
goals.hint: Steam Turbine Controller + turbine module + steam input + RF Output.
goals.why: Power from heat-exchanger or boiler steam.
steps: Connect a Steam Turbine Controller, turbine module, steam input and RF Output.
Feed it steady steam.
Connect a load and watch the Controller while the rotor spins up.

goals.text: Use a heat exchanger or syngas machine to produce a useful fluid
goals.hint: Heat exchangers make steam; syngas machines make fuel gas.
goals.why: Fuel for your turbines.
steps: Pick the Heat Exchanger or Syngas machine and get its controller and modules.
Connect the modules; right-click the Controller to see what is missing.
Supply the inputs and connect empty output storage.
Check the Controller's readings, then pipe the product to a turbine.

goals.text: Build a Solar Array Tier 1 Multiblock Structure
goals.hint: Environmental Tech solar array: a controller and structure blocks (JEI).
goals.why: Lots of daytime power from one controller.
steps: Craft the controller, 16 tier-1 structure blocks, 9 solar cells and 4 modifiers (any modifier block).
Build the layers around the controller.
Right-click the controller: it lists what is missing until the structure is complete.

diagram.title: Solar Array tier 1
diagram.view: K is the controller. Any tier 1-or-higher structure block works.
diagram.note: K = controller. The 9 solar cells sit on top in the middle.

goals.text: Harness the power of Lightning with a Lightning Rod
goals.hint: A lightning rod structure turns storms into power.
goals.why: Large power bursts from thunderstorms.
steps: Build the lightning rod structure high up under open sky.
Right-click the controller to check it.

diagram.title: Lightning Rod tier 1
diagram.view: K is the controller. Any tier 1-or-higher structure block works.
diagram.note: Stack the rod straight up above the controller.

goals.text: Use an Angel Block and your ability to fly to build an outpost above a landmark
goals.hint: Angel blocks can be placed in mid-air.
goals.why: Start a sky build anywhere.
steps: Craft angel blocks.
Place one in the air and build on it.

goals.text: Assemble a Create Train between your base and an outpost
goals.hint: Lay track, place stations and assemble a train with controls.
goals.why: Fast travel and cargo between bases, farms and mines.
steps: Lay track between two stations.
Build a train on the track with controls and bogeys.
Assemble it at the station.

goals.text: Keep a contraption afloat with Levitite
goals.hint: Crystallize Levitite Blend into Levitite: enough of it floats a contraption without a balloon.
goals.why: The blend needs 2 Aether ambrosium shards per batch, so lift comes with the Aether (Age 5).
goals.tip: Crystallized Levitite can't be scooped up again, and mould blocks inside the pool are destroyed. Pearlescent Levitite is decorative.
steps: Crush End Stone with Crushing Wheels into End Stone Powder.
Heated Mechanical Mixer (Blaze Burner under the basin): 4 End Stone Powder + 2 zinc nuggets + 2 ambrosium shards + 500 mB water = Levitite Blend.
Pour the blend into a block mould where you want it, then heat it (lit Blaze Burner, campfire or lava next to it): the whole pool crystallizes.
Build the Levitite into your ship and assemble it. Levitite holds it up; propellers move it and make it climb.

obtain.aeronautics:end_stone_powder: Put End Stone through Create Crushing Wheels (each block gives one powder, sometimes the end stone back too).
obtain.aeronautics:levitite_blend_bucket: Mix 4 End Stone Powder, 2 zinc nuggets, 2 ambrosium shards and 500 mB of water in a heated Mechanical Mixer, then take the Levitite Blend out of the basin with a bucket (or a spout or pipe).
obtain.aeronautics:levitite: Not crafted: pour Levitite Blend into place and heat it (a lit Blaze Burner, campfire or lava next to it). The fluid crystallizes into Levitite where it stands; once crystallized it cannot be scooped back up.

goals.text: Locate a Stronghold and travel to the End
goals.hint: Throw eyes of ender to find the stronghold, then fill the portal frame.
goals.why: The Ender Dragon, End cities, shulkers and elytra; Draconic Evolution starts here.
steps: Craft about 14 eyes of ender (ender pearl + blaze powder).
Throw one up and walk where it flies.
Dig down where it falls to the portal room.
Fill the 12 frames with eyes and jump in.

diagram.title: End portal
diagram.view: Top view (already built in the stronghold)
diagram.note: Put an Eye of Ender in every frame that is missing one.

obtain.minecraft:end_portal_frame: Cannot be crafted or picked up: the frame is already built in the stronghold portal room. You only add Eyes of Ender.

goals.text: Kill the Ender Dragon
goals.hint: Destroy the end crystals on the pillars first.
goals.why: Opens the End gateways (End cities) and gives the dragon egg and dragon's breath.
steps: Bring a bow, many arrows, blocks and slow falling or water.
Shoot the end crystals on the pillars.
Hit the dragon when it perches.

obtain.minecraft:dragon_head: Found on ships in End Cities; a Dragon Head is not dropped by the dragon.

mobs.where: Lives on the main End island; reach it through the End portal in a stronghold. After the first fight, summon it again by placing 4 End Crystals around the exit portal.

goals.text: Collect Dragon's Breath
goals.hint: Use empty bottles on the dragon's purple breath cloud.
goals.why: For lingering potions and some mod recipes.
steps: During the dragon fight, use empty bottles on the purple cloud.

obtain.minecraft:dragon_breath: Use empty glass bottles on the purple breath clouds of the Ender Dragon.

mobs.where: Lives on the main End island; reach it through the End portal in a stronghold. After the first fight, summon it again by placing 4 End Crystals around the exit portal.

goals.text: Resurrect the Ender Dragon with End Crystals
goals.hint: Place an end crystal on each of the four sides of the exit portal.
goals.why: Fight it again for more XP (the egg drops only once).
steps: Craft 4 end crystals.
Place one on each side of the exit portal.

goals.text: Travel to an End City and obtain Elytra
goals.hint: End cities are on the outer End islands; elytra hang inside their ships.
goals.why: Glide, and fly fast with fireworks.
steps: Throw an ender pearl into a small End gateway.
Search the outer islands for an End city with a ship.
Take the elytra from the item frame in the ship.

obtain.minecraft:elytra: Hangs in an item frame inside the ships of End cities.

goals.text: Craft a Shulker Box
goals.hint: Two shulker shells around a chest. A shulker box keeps its contents when broken.
goals.why: A portable chest.
steps: Kill shulkers in End cities for shells.
Craft the box: two shells around a chest.
Break it with items inside: they stay inside.

goals.text: Eat an End Cake to visit the End
goals.hint: Each End Cake slice teleports you to the End.
goals.why: A quick trip back to the End.
steps: Craft the End Cake and place it.
Eat a slice.

goals.text: Hatch a Dragon Egg and train it
goals.hint: Dragon Mounts: hatch an egg (its biome decides the type), tame and saddle it.
goals.why: Your own rideable dragon.
steps: Place the egg in the biome you want.
Right-click it and wait for it to hatch.
Feed it fish to tame it; saddle it to ride.

mobs.where: Right-click a dragon egg (the vanilla one from the Ender Dragon, or a Dragon Mounts breed egg) to start hatching; keep it warm and wait for the dragon.

goals.text: Defeat the Ender Calamity
goals.hint: A CQR boss in its End arena, reachable after the Dragon.
goals.why: The hardest Chocolate Quest boss: a test of your Age 5 gear.
steps: Kill the Ender Dragon, then explore the End islands.
Destroy its crystals, keep moving and fight from range when it throws blocks.

mobs.where: A CQR boss in its own arena in the End; meet it after the Ender Dragon.

goals.text: Smelt Draconium Ore into Draconium Ingots
goals.hint: Draconium ore: deep Overworld, the Nether and the End.
goals.why: Draconic Evolution starts with Draconium: cores, fusion crafting, energy storage.
steps: Find draconium ore (deepslate, Nether or End).
Smelt it into ingots.

goals.text: Build a Fusion Crafting setup
goals.hint: A Fusion Crafting Core with injectors around it crafts Draconic items.
goals.why: Every Draconic tool, armor and upgrade is fusion-crafted.
steps: Craft a Fusion Crafting Core and at least 4 Basic Fusion Crafting Injectors (more for big recipes).
Place the injectors facing the core, in line with it, a few blocks away (left/right or above/below).
Center item in the core, ingredients in the injectors; power the injectors and start the craft.

goals.text: Make a Dislocator
goals.hint: Bind a Dislocator to a place, then teleport there.
